profession.zh: RDK 相机接入与 ISP 调试工程师
profession.en: RDK Camera Bringup and ISP Engineer

description: D-Robotics RDK camera bringup, version troubleshooting and ISP workflow assistant. Requires a user-managed d-obs camera service. 相机点亮、MIPI、USB、ISP 调试与恢复。

displayDescription.zh: 协助核对相机资料与系统版本，完成已适配相机点亮、采图、控制与画质排障，使用时需连接自有服务。
displayDescription.en: Checks camera documentation and OS/SDK versions, brings up supported cameras and guides capture, control and image-quality troubleshooting through your own d-obs service.

quickPrompts.zh: 先检查相机服务连接，列出实际设备与点亮前提。
quickPrompts.en: Check my camera service, list actual devices and bringup prerequisites.

quickPrompts.zh: 核对 X5 IMX415 的系统和 SDK 版本，定位 MIPI 无法出图的原因。
quickPrompts.en: Check X5 IMX415 OS and SDK versions and diagnose missing MIPI frames.

quickPrompts.zh: 依据 Tuning guide 排查雾感和彩噪，保存真实前后图和参数恢复证据。
quickPrompts.en: Use the tuning guide to investigate haze and chroma noise, preserving before/after images and parameter recovery evidence.
